name: Acuity Scheduling
description_en:
Acuity Scheduling provides client self-booking for appointment-based businesses. It combines availability, intake forms, reminders, payment/deposit collection and calendar connections, with separate plans for different calendar counts and advanced selling/administration features.

The current site explicitly says there is no ongoing free scheduling plan. A seven-day no-card trial lets a business evaluate the booking workflow before selecting a paid plan.
description_zh:
Acuity Scheduling 为预约型业务提供客户自助预订，将可约时间、资料表单、提醒、付款／订金与日历连接结合起来，按日历数量及高级销售／管理功能分档。

当前官网明确说明没有持续免费的预约套餐。七天无需信用卡的试用，让业务方在选择付费方案前评估预订工作流。

core_features.explanation_en: Publish a booking page with availability, buffers and intake questions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 发布含可约时间、缓冲和资料问题的预约页。

core_features.explanation_en: Collect deposits/payments and send confirmations; SMS has tier/region conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 收取订金／付款并发送确认，短信有档位／地区条件。

core_features.explanation_en: Export bookings and optionally block time from external busy events.
core_features.explanation_zh: 导出预约，可选以外部忙碌事件阻挡时段。

en: Collect intake and a deposit while a client books a service.
zh: 客户预约服务时收集资料及订金。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor-hosted scheduling with web/mobile administration and external connectors.
Deployment.zh: 厂商托管预约，提供网页／移动管理与外部连接器。

steps.en: Define one appointment type, availability, buffers and intake form.
steps.zh: 定义一种预约、可用时间、缓冲与资料表单。

steps.en: Connect the required calendar and test a representative booking/reschedule in Acuity.
steps.zh: 连接所需日历，在 Acuity 内测试代表性预订／改期。

steps.en: Confirm plan, payment processor and reminder region before inviting real clients.
steps.zh: 邀请真实客户前确认套餐、支付渠道和提醒地区。

items.en: Troubleshooting guidance separates wrong account/calendar selection, time-zone differences, duplicated cross-sync routes and authorisation changes. Initial sync can take around 30 minutes; events marked free may not block time. Check the authoritative appointment and the outside calendar in a browser before deleting/recreating records. Acuity fits client scheduling beyond a basic meeting link; no self-hosted edition, open-source licence, payment test or guaranteed sync/recovery latency was established here.
items.zh: 排障指南区分账户／日历选错、时区不同、交叉同步重复和授权变化。首次同步可能约需 30 分钟，标为“空闲”的事件可能不阻挡时段。删除／重建记录前，应核对权威预约及浏览器中的外部日历。Acuity 适合超出简单会议链接的客户预约；未核实自行托管版、开源许可、支付实测或同步／恢复时延保证。

pricing.billing_basis: Plan/calendar capacity; annual or monthly, taxes excluded.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Annual-billed monthly equivalents $16/$27/$55; monthly $20/$34/$69. Seven-day no-card trial; no perpetual free scheduling plan.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 年付折算月价 16／27／55 美元；按月 20／34／69。七天无需信用卡试用；无永久免费预约方案。

sections.title_en: Make one service bookable end to end
sections.title_zh: 让一项服务完整可预约
sections.en: An illustrative consultation setup defines the appointment type, working hours, buffers and daily booking limits, then collects intake answers and an optional required deposit. A client selects a slot on a branded standalone or embedded page and receives confirmation/reminders. Verify the displayed time zone, form answers and payment state in the actual booking record. A page accepting a booking is not proof that every external calendar or payment workflow has completed.
sections.zh: 例如配置咨询服务时，先定义预约类型、工作时间、缓冲和每日上限，再收集资料表答案及可选的必付订金。客户在品牌独立页或嵌入页选择时段，收到确认／提醒。应在真实预约记录核对显示时区、表单答案与付款状态。页面接受预约不证明所有外部日历或支付流程已经完成。

sections.title_en: Calendars, paid features and processor charges
sections.title_zh: 日历、付费功能与支付渠道费用
sections.en: The USD page shows annual-billed monthly equivalents of Starter $16, Standard $27 and Premium $55, alongside monthly $20/$34/$69, excluding tax. Calendar allowances are one, six and 36 respectively. Standard adds SMS reminders subject to global availability, packages/memberships and waitlists. Premium adds multiple staff/location time zones, API/CSS and the option to sign a BAA. A BAA option is not an independent compliance finding; processor costs and regional SMS/payment eligibility need separate checks.
sections.zh: 美元页展示年付折算月价 Starter 16、Standard 27、Premium 55，旁列按月 20／34／69，均未含税。日历额度分别一、六、36。Standard 增加受地区可用性约束的短信提醒、套餐／会员与候补。Premium 增加员工／地点多时区、API／CSS 及签署 BAA 的选项。可签 BAA 不代表独立合规结论；支付渠道费用及地区短信／支付资格需另查。

sections.title_en: Do not equate two-way sync with external editing
sections.title_zh: 不能把双向同步等同于外部编辑
sections.en: The detailed sync guide says availability remains set in Acuity; outside events block time only when configured. Acuity appointment changes must be made inside Acuity: changes made to the exported event are overwritten on a later sync. This conflicts with a broad external-editing FAQ on the marketing calendar page, so use the detailed guide as the operating instruction and verify your connector. Class attendees appear as individual external events only after someone books, and buffers do not export as appointment time.
sections.zh: 详细同步指南说明：可用时间仍在 Acuity 设置，外部事件需配置后才阻挡时段。Acuity 预约必须在 Acuity 内修改；直接改导出的事件会在后续同步被覆盖。这与营销日历页笼统的外部编辑 FAQ 冲突，因此应以详细指南作为操作依据并验证具体连接器。有人预订后，课程参与者才分别出现在外部事件中；缓冲不作为预约时长导出。
